title: Choose the Graphonomicon identity
question: The roll assigned the Isotype Wall Chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Isotype Wall Chart
options.thesis: A classroom wall chart: flat colour, bold condensed caps, one idea per panel.
options.viewport: Wordmark with a three-bar mark, big imperative headline, a flat demand/supply diagram, unit tiles in solid colour.
options.risk: Heavy caps can feel shouty on dense graph pages.

raised.raise: The mark is built from the same bars-on-a-grid logic as the chart, so logo and diagram share one construction.

options.label: De Stijl Planes
options.thesis: Solid colour planes split by black rules, like the shaded regions on a graph.
options.viewport: Ruled header cells, a blue lead panel, and unit tiles as red, yellow and black planes.
options.risk: Primary red and yellow compete with the demand/supply colours on graph pages.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: A visible graph-paper grid with a monumental letterform.
options.viewport: Giant SD letterforms on a blue grid with unit cards beside it.
options.case: Graph paper is familiar to students, but it works as a home page better than as a backdrop for a chart.
options.risk: A grid behind the chart would clash with the plotted axes.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.case: Its single-size type rule fights chart labels.
options.kept: Rank carried by weight and case rather than size.

options.label: Metro Typographic Tiles
options.case: Black ground and cropped type hurt chart legibility.

options.label: Doujin Event Catalog
options.case: Postage-stamp density does not suit interactive graphs.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.case: Cream and engraved italic is the default look and says nothing about economics.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.case: A departures board costume is wrong for a learning tool.
options.kept: Values that change character by character.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white-card education tool in the existing blue, serif plus Plex.
canonCard.viewport: Serif headline, three white unit cards with accent top borders.
